source_note: 素数定理的一些等价命题
english_source_note: Equivalent Statements of the Prime Number Theorem
callout_id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#4
statement_en:
Let $b>0$, and let $f(n)$ be a nonnegative arithmetic function. Write $$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}$$ for its associated Dirichlet series.

Assume that the series converges absolutely in the region $\mathrm{Re}(s)>b$, and that it admits analytic continuation to $\mathrm{Re}(s)\geq b$ as a meromorphic function $F(s)$. Suppose that in this region the function has exactly one simple pole, namely at $s=b$. If the residue of $F(s)$ at $s=b$ is $c$, then $$\sum_{n\leq x} f(n)\sim \frac{c}{b}x^b.$$
callout_body:
设$b>0$,$f(n)$是一个非负的算术函数，记$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}$是其对应的Dirichlet级数。

假设级数在$\text{Re}(s)> b$的范围内绝对收敛，并且可以解析延拓到$\text{Re}(s)\geq b$并定义亚纯函数$F(s)$,该函数在此范围内有且仅有$s=b$这一个简单极点。假设$F(s)$在$s=b$处的留数为$c$,那么$$\sum_{n\leq x} f(n)\sim \frac{c}{b}x^b$$
